question: A, B, C and D can do a piece of work separately in 30 days, 33 days, 36 days and 44 days, respectively. In how many days can A and B together complete the work, if A and B together are assisted by C and D on alternate two-two days starting with C for first two days, then D on next two days and again C on next two days and so on?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(30, 33, 36, 44) = 1980 units.

Efficiencies: A = 66, B = 60, C = 55, D = 45 units/day.

Work in 4-day cycle = 2 × (A + B + C) + 2 × (A + B + D) = 2 × 181 + 2 × 171 = 704 units.

Work in 8 days (2 cycles) = 1408 units. Remaining = 1980 − 1408 = 572 units.

In next 3 days, work done = 362 (by A, B, C in 2 days) + 171 (by A, B, D in 1 day) = 533 units.

Remaining 39 units takes 39 ÷ 171 = 13/57 days. Total time = 11 + 13/57 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 11¹³⁄₅₇ days.**
